knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Excess water causes damage and mould.
Warm cords are stopped and reported.
The pre-use check covers the safety and recovery parts.

practicalCriteria: Completes a pre-use check on a sample extraction machine.
Extracts a sample item with controlled moisture.
Stops and disconnects the machine at a simulated electrical fault, and reports it.
passRule: Pre-use check complete, moisture controlled, and electrical fault stopped and reported. Observed by an assessor. Not an electrical licence.
stopWorkCriteria: Machine with a damaged cord or cracked hose used
